# GarboChess-JS (vendored, unchanged)

- **What**: a chess engine in plain JavaScript by Gary Linscott, used as phpChess's first computer-opponent engine (AI-01).
- **Source**: https://github.com/glinscott/Garbochess-JS, file `js/garbochess.js`, last changed in commit `4ff0f9e49a0041545b645e25d3d2da7af3b36a90` (2012-12-25).
- **Licence**: BSD-3-Clause, see `LICENSE` beside this file.
- **SHA-256** of `garbochess.js`: `b0ebcf80e7bc7c5c9dd08e57f96a07af0a655f6138590243028d6b98717c938c`
- **Changes**: none. This file is kept byte-for-byte as published. phpChess's own code that uses it lives in `public/assets/js/engine/`.
- **Network calls**: none. A search of the file finds no `XMLHttpRequest`, `fetch`, `importScripts` or `WebSocket`; it only talks to the page through `postMessage`.
